ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Rice is the most important grain crop in China. Rice blast is a disease caused by infection of rice by the rice blast fungus (Mp), and it seriously endangers the safety of China’s grain production. Compared with the use of pesticides, the utilization of rice blast resistance genes is a more effective, safe, and economical measure for controlling rice blast. There are currently three rice disease-resistant varieties, Jia (R1R1r2r2r3r3), Yi (r1r1R2R2r3r3), and Bing (r1r1r2r2R3R3). Disease resistance (R) is dominant over susceptibility (r), and the three pairs of disease-resistance genes are located on different chromosomes. Specific primers are designed according to the DNA sequences of the genes, and the PCR method can distinguish R1, r1, R2, r2, R3, and r3 in the samples. This method can be used for genotype identification in the breeding of disease-resistant varieties. After variety Jia is crossed with a susceptible variety, R1 and r1 of different F2 plants are amplified by PCR. It is known that the R1 fragment is shorter than the r1 fragment. From the amplification results (figure below), infer which plants can be disease-resistant?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows the gel electrophoresis results after PCR amplification, and the lanes are labeled M, 1, 2, and 3 in order. M is the standard DNA fragment, with the upper about 400 bp and the lower about 200 bp marked on the left. The lane of plant 1 has only one band at a lower position, with a shorter fragment; the lane of plant 2 has only one band at a higher position, with a longer fragment; the lane of plant 3 has both a higher band and a lower band. Then reason: The question stem states that the R1 fragment is shorter than the r1 fragment, so the lower short band corresponds to R1, and the higher long band corresponds to r1. Plant 1 has only the short band, and its genotype is R1R1; plant 2 has only the long band, and its genotype is r1r1; plant 3 has both long and short bands, and its genotype is R1r1. Since the disease-resistance gene R is dominant over the susceptibility gene r, resistance is expressed as long as R1 is present, so plant 1 and plant 3 can be disease-resistant.
